name: Host process fixture acceptance

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, converted_to_draft]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/host-process-acceptance.yml'
      - 'agent-teams-controller/**'
      - 'packages/legacy-agent-host/**'
      - 'packages/task-change-ledger/**'
      - 'src/features/agent-backend/**'
      - 'src/main/utils/ownedProcess/**'
      - 'src/main/utils/childProcess.ts'
      - 'src/main/utils/electronNodeLaunch.ts'
      - 'src/main/utils/linuxNodeExecArtifact.ts'
      - 'src/main/services/team/WorkspaceMcpBundle.ts'
      - 'test/main/build/electronBuilderAfterPack.test.ts'
      - 'test/features/agent-backend/**'
      - 'tools/owned-process-broker/**'
      - 'scripts/build/buildOwnedProcessBroker.ts'
      - 'tools/linux-node-exec/**'
      - 'scripts/build/buildLinuxNodeExec.mjs'
      - 'scripts/dev-with-runtime.mjs'
      - 'scripts/build/linuxNodeExec.native.test.mjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/afterPack.cjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/dist.mjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/verifyLinuxNodeExec.cjs'
      - 'scripts/ci/**'
      - 'scripts/ensure-electron-install.cjs'
      - 'vendor/provider-migration/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Draft-safe process fixtures have their own evidence; existing native-provider gates remain intact.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

jobs:
  process-fixtures:
    name: Host process fixtures (${{ matrix.platform }})
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: ubuntu-24.04
            platform: linux-x64
            arch: x64
          - runner: macos-15
            platform: darwin-arm64
            arch: arm64
          - runner: macos-15-intel
            platform: darwin-x64
            arch: x64
          - runner: windows-2022
            platform: win32-x64
            arch: x64
          - runner: windows-11-arm
            platform: win32-arm64
            arch: arm64
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      HOST_PROCESS_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HOST_PROCESS_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      # Use the exact Corepack bundled with the selected Node; avoid a second
      # package-manager bootstrap and native-engine self-switch on macOS Intel.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Select the pinned package manager with bundled Corepack
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(corepack --version)" = 0.36.0
          corepack enable
          corepack install --global pnpm@11.22.0
          test "$(pnpm --version)" = 11.22.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Bind exact source and actual process tuple
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_PROCESS_SOURCE_HEAD"
          node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; assert.equal(process.version,'v24.21.0'); assert.equal(process.platform+'-'+process.arch,process.env.HOST_PROCESS_PLATFORM)"
          mkdir process-acceptance-evidence
          git rev-parse HEAD > process-acceptance-evidence/source-head.txt
      - name: Install frozen workspace without Desktop postinstall

                  assert.ok(typeof receipt.proofDigest === 'string' && /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(receipt.proofDigest));
                  const drain = cleanupShape(evidence.drain, ['state', 'afterStopReceiptRef']);
                  assert.equal(drain.state, 'complete'); assert.equal(drain.afterStopReceiptRef, stop.receiptRef);
                  const release = cleanupShape(evidence.release, ['state', 'receiptRef']);
                  assert.equal(release.state, 'released'); assert.equal(release.receiptRef, stop.receiptRef);
                  const observed = cleanupShape(evidence.observedCalls, ['allocate', 'prepare', 'resume']);
                  for (const phase of ['allocate', 'prepare', 'resume']) {
                    const counts = cleanupShape(observed[phase], ['calls', 'settled', 'returned']);
                    for (const field of ['calls', 'settled', 'returned']) assert.equal(counts[field], phase === 'allocate' ? 1 : 0);
                  }
                  assert.equal(job.root, null); assert.equal(job.entryStart, null); assert.equal(job.entryEnd, null);
                  assert.equal(job.resumed, false); assert.equal(job.originalHandleAbsent, false);
                  for (const field of ['stopped', 'drained', 'released']) assert.equal(job[field], true);
                }
              }
              const originalController = rows(log).filter(value => value.gateController);
              assert.deepEqual(originalController, [{ gateController: 'drained', rootExitCode: 0, activeProcesses: 0 }]);
              native.push({ log, scope: 'captured Main Host source A/B with finite ' + provider + ' peer', receipt: proof });
            }
          } else assert.equal(process.platform, 'darwin');
          writeFileSync(join(directory, 'scope.json'), JSON.stringify({
            kind: 'TEST_HOST_PROCESS_FIXTURE_ACCEPTANCE', status: 'PASS',
            sourceHead: process.env.HOST_PROCESS_SOURCE_HEAD, platform: process.env.HOST_PROCESS_PLATFORM,
            nodeVersion: process.version, controlledContracts: true, retainedMainTransport: true,
            posixProcessGroups: process.platform !== 'win32', native,
            nativeProviderRuntimeQualified: false, darwinNativeRegistrationQualified: false,
            posixExecutableAdmissionQualified: false, desktopQualified: false, releaseQualified: false,
          }, null, 2) + '\n');
          NODE
      - name: Preserve original process evidence including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: host-process-fixtures-${{ matrix.platform }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            native-evidence/
            process-acceptance-evidence/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-process-node24-${{ github.run_id }}/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-process-electron-${{ github.run_id }}/
